children: AS Pro Kapital Grupp is organising a webinar on Wednesday, 9 September 2026, to present the company’s operations, development portfolio and the proposed public offering of bonds, provided that the prospectus for the public offering of bonds has been approved in advance and published on the AS Pro Kapital Grupp website.
Registration for the webinar is open via the link:
Registration for the webinar is open via the link:

During the webinar, Andrus Laurits, Managing Director of AS Pro Kapital Grupp, and Ann-Kristin Kuusik, CFO, will provide an overview of the company’s financial results, development portfolio and future plans. Following this, together with Silver Kalmus, Debt Securities area manager at AS LHV Pank, they will present AS Pro Kapital Grupp’s planned bond issue and the intended use of the capital raised.
The webinar will be recorded and the recording will be published on the AS Pro Kapital Grupp website after the event:

This is a securities advertisement within the meaning of EU Regulation 2017/1129/EU. Each investor must make an investment decision solely on the basis of the information contained in the prospectus, the bond terms and conditions, the final terms and other documents published on the website of AS Pro Kapital Grupp: https://www.prokapital.com/et/bond-issue2026/. ) should not be understood as an endorsement of the bonds offered by AS Pro Kapital Grupp. If necessary, consult an expert.

This notice is for information purposes only, refers to a possible future offer and does not constitute an offer, sale or invitation to subscribe for the bonds. This is not an offer to sell or a solicitation of an offer to buy any securities of AS Pro Kapital Grupp, nor any recommendation or investment advice. No offer of bonds will take place in any jurisdiction until the required offering documents have been approved, registered or published.
